question: What is the application processing fee? Explain any discrepancy between the FAQ and Spring 2027 notice.
actual_answer:
The general FAQ states that candidates pay Rs. 1000/- as the basic application processing fee. [compendium_faqs.pdf]

The Spring 2027 admission info states an on-campus processing fee of Rs. 1,500 and an online-only undergraduate processing fee of Rs. 2,500. [03_current_policy.md]

These are conflicting or differently scoped source claims rather than independently established effective-date revisions, and verification is advised. [03_current_policy.md]

question: What maximum percentage of total program credits can transfer to DSU?
